scope: Live private Photon room: rendered Editor host and two independent Realtime peers. Verifies transport, sender ownership, shared progress, late join and host handoff. Remote rendered UI and physical Android are not verified.

checks.name: Independent clients share an invisible private room
Native player retains local control ownership
Remote replica cannot consume host input
Guest Book starts the original ten-minute tree clock and reserves T10
Wrong tree identification keeps the choice and charges authenticated sender exactly once and ten seconds
Replayed tree confirmation cannot charge another mistake
Late join restores every branch, selected node and exact remaining deadline
Teammate completes identification and all peers enter the same paused Book gate
Solved tree Book gate preserves the exact saved time
Unfinished Trees cannot be exchanged for a different topic
Teammates keep independent pending parent picks in the shared checkpoint
A guest cannot borrow another actor's pending endpoint selection
Accepted branch clears only its sender's pick and retains the teammate's pick
Master handoff preserves physical tree, exact deadline and both actors' pending picks
Collaboratively built tree completes through the source validator
Authority requires removing the old parent before connecting a replacement
Captured player's pending pick clears while the other teammate stays free
Captured guest cannot forge a branch edit
Remote directed-branch removal accepts either selected endpoint order
Departure clears only the former pending pick, retaining repaired branches and mistake identity
Teammate can confirm the repaired tree after capture and departure
Authority enforces the original number choices zero through five
Clear Pick preserves the readonly original tree
Timeout keeps solved challenges, branches and number, attributing one mistake to its Book activator
Guest Book retry resumes the same depth variant and number in a fresh attempt
Source edge-count answer completes the depth challenge
Spanning edits cannot invent a branch outside the original graph
Guest snapshot spoof cannot force final-topic completion
Spanning result contains every vertex and no cycle using source edges
All five shared tree challenges finish and release the next topic reservation
Tree transport checks preserve all other topic states and clocks
